190	//  THE PER-TILE TP BLOCK FUNCTIONS (the megakernel-tiling math). All reuse the
191	//  PRODUCTION wgmma tile GEMMs (dectc_gemm_fwd_f32 / dectc_gemm_dx_f32 — fp32
192	//  accumulate, kTileM=128-row tiles, identical staging) on the rank's DENSE
193	//  shard; zero new GEMM math. `Wshard` is templated on the weight dtype (WT):
194	//  the loopback test passes fp32 params (const float*, the fp32→bf16-on-read
195	//  GEMM overload); the production megakernel passes the PRECONVERTED bf16 cache
196	//  (const __nv_bfloat16*, DecWBf::*). dectc_gemm_fwd_f32/_dx_f32 overload on the
197	//  W pointer type, so the right body is selected automatically for each caller.
198	//
199	//  COLUMN-parallel forward:  Y_own[M, Nout/P] = X[M,Kin] @ Wshard^T.
200	//  Comm-free; the output IS the rank's feature shard.
201	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
202	template <int N, class WT>
203	__device__ __forceinline__ void tp_colparallel_fwd_tile(
204	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ X, const WT* __restrict__ Wshard,
205	        float* __restrict__ Yown, int Kin, int Nout_local,
206	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
207	    dectc::dectc_gemm_fwd_f32<N>(X, Wshard, Yown, Kin, Nout_local, sA, sB);
208	}
209

211	// written DIRECTLY into this PE's symmetric slot (the publish). The caller then
212	// crosses the rendezvous and runs the fixed-order reduce (all-reduce point ①/②).
213	template <int N, class Transport, class WT>
214	__device__ __forceinline__ void tp_rowparallel_fwd_partial_tile(
215	        const Transport& tr, int64_t slot_off,
216	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ Xown, const WT* __restrict__ Wshard,
217	        int Kin_local, int Nout,
218	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
219	    dectc::dectc_gemm_fwd_f32<N>(Xown, Wshard, tr.local(slot_off),
220	                                 Kin_local, Nout, sA, sB);
221	}

223	// ROW-parallel backward dX (comm-free): dXown[M, Kin/P] = dY[M, Nout] @ Wshard.
224	// dY is the FULL-width adjoint (the row-parallel output was all-reduced, so its
225	// adjoint is replicated); Wshard is the rank's [Nout, Kin/P] dense col-shard.
226	template <int N, class WT>
227	__device__ __forceinline__ void tp_rowparallel_dx_tile(
228	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ dY, const WT* __restrict__ Wshard,
229	        float* __restrict__ dXown, int Kin_local, int Nout,
230	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
231	    dectc::dectc_gemm_dx_f32<N>(dY, Wshard, dXown, Kin_local, Nout, sA, sB);
232	}

234	// COLUMN-parallel backward dX PARTIAL (the conjugate comm point ①'/②'):
235	// dXpart[M, Kin] = dYown[M, Nout/P] @ Wshard, published to the symmetric slot;
236	// caller rendezvous + fixed-order reduce ⇒ dX = Σ_pe dXpart.
237	template <int N, class Transport, class WT>
238	__device__ __forceinline__ void tp_colparallel_dx_partial_tile(
239	        const Transport& tr, int64_t slot_off,
240	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ dYown, const WT* __restrict__ Wshard,
241	        int Kin, int Nout_local,
242	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
243	    dectc::dectc_gemm_dx_f32<N>(dYown, Wshard, tr.local(slot_off),
244	                                Kin, Nout_local, sA, sB);
245	}

247	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
248	//  dW under TP — the exact-slice property (NO comm, the P2 machinery carries
249	//  over unchanged). For a COLUMN-parallel weight, the rank's
250	//      dW_own[Nout/P, Kin] = dY_own^T @ X        (X full/replicated)
251	//  is bit-for-bit rows [own_lo, own_hi) of the unsharded dW (same ascending-K
252	//  fp32 contraction over the same T). For a ROW-parallel weight,
253	//      dW_own[Nout, Kin/P] = dY^T @ X_own        (dY full/replicated)
254	//  is bit-for-bit cols [own_lo, own_hi). So P2's output-stationary dW spec for
255	//  a TP rank is the SAME DecDwSpec with (dY, Nout) or (X, Kin) swapped for the
256	//  rank-local stream/extent — this helper performs that transform. Biases:
257	//  col-parallel db_own = Σ_K dY_own (the own rows of db); row-parallel /
258	//  replicated db = Σ_K dY computed identically on every rank.
259	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
260	__device__ __host__ __forceinline__ void tp_shard_extents(
261	        TpSplit split, int P, int Nout_full, int Kin_full,
262	        int* Nout_local, int* Kin_local) {
263	    switch (split) {
264	        case TpSplit::Col:
265	        case TpSplit::ColQKV: *Nout_local = Nout_full / P; *Kin_local = Kin_full;     break;
266	        case TpSplit::Row:    *Nout_local = Nout_full;     *Kin_local = Kin_full / P; break;
267	        default:              *Nout_local = Nout_full;     *Kin_local = Kin_full;     break;
268	    }
269	}

272	//  Symmetric-slot budget for one decoder layer's TP comm, in floats, per tile
273	//  row block of kTileM rows: the largest reduced payload is [kTileM, d] (both
274	//  fwd reduces and both bwd reduces are [rows, d]). The canonical heap plan
275	//  (the loopback binding + the future NVSHMEM bootstrap both size with this):
276	//      slot 0: partial  [kTileM · d]      (publish target)
277	//      slot 1: reduced  [kTileM · d]      (reduce output, when not fused into
278	//                                          a local consumer buffer)
279	//  per CONCURRENT tile in flight per PE. The persistent kernel runs ONE tile
280	//  per CTA at a time ⇒ heap stride = n_ctas_per_pe · 2 · kTileM · d floats.
281	// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
282	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t tp_tile_slot_floats() {
283	    return (int64_t)dectc::kTileM * dec::kD;
284	}
285	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t tp_heap_stride_floats(int ctas_per_pe) {
286	    return (int64_t)ctas_per_pe * 2 * tp_tile_slot_floats();
287	}

871	    staged-opt budget is linear in (== kDecMaxTensorNumel/tp when the max tensor splits).
872	
873	    LOUD on a split dim that ``tp`` does not divide (the Megatron geometry requires
874	    ``out_features % tp == 0`` for column and ``in_features % tp == 0`` for row — at the
875	    flagship d=1600 every split dim is a multiple of 8/4/2/1, but a bad (tp, model) pair
876	    must fail here, never silently mis-shard). At tp==1 every tensor is replicated whole
877	    (the byte-identical single-GPU fold — TPShardPlan.total_shard_numel == total).
878	    """
879	    tp = int(tp)
880	    if tp < 1:
881	        raise ValueError(f"tp must be >= 1, got {tp}")
882	    if not (0 <= tp_rank < tp):
883	        raise ValueError(f"tp_rank {tp_rank} out of range for tp {tp}")
884	    if model != "decoder":
885	        # The column/row roster is the decoder's; other cells reuse the same
886	        # mechanism with their own roster. Loud rather than silently mis-classify.
887	        raise ValueError(
888	            f"partition_tensor_parallel: model={model!r} unsupported "
889	            f"(only 'decoder' has a Megatron col/row roster wired here)")
890	
891	    shards: List[TPTensorShard] = []
892	    for name, size in named_sizes:
893	        full_numel, shape = _as_numel_shape(size)
894	        if full_numel < 0:
895	            raise ValueError(f"tensor {name!r} has negative numel {full_numel}")
896	        if tp == 1:
897	            shards.append(TPTensorShard(name, full_numel, TP_REPLICATED,
898	                                        full_numel, 0, 0, -1))

"""tests/hw/nvshmem_smoke.py — the CROSS-GPU NVSHMEM bring-up SMOKE (capability track).

WHAT THIS PROVES (the genuine multi-GPU gate, not a 1-GPU loopback):
  Launch N processes (one per GPU) under torchrun, and on each:
    1. JIT-build the host NVSHMEM bring-up pybind (csrc/fused/sm_90/
       nvshmem_bringup_pybind.cpp), linked host-only against libnvshmem_host.so.3.
    2. Bootstrap NVSHMEM via the UID path: rank 0 calls get_uniqueid(); the 128-byte
       blob is broadcast over torch.distributed (NCCL); EVERY rank calls
       init_with_uniqueid(rank, world, uid) — the NVSHMEMX_INIT_WITH_UNIQUEID
       bootstrap the present nvshmem_bootstrap_uid.so.3 plugin implements (MPI/PMI
       are absent on this box).
    3. Carve THIS rank's TP team via nvshmem_team_split_strided with the
       (PE_start, PE_stride, PE_size) the host_bringup.TPBootstrap plan resolves
       (single-node pure TP ⇒ (0, 1, world) ⇒ the team == NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD).
    4. COLLECTIVE nvshmem_malloc of the symmetric heap (sized to
       host_bringup.tp_heap_stride_floats(ctas_per_pe), matching the launcher's
       dec_tc_ensure_tp_sym_heap exactly).
    5. A tiny TEAM-scoped all-reduce of (world_pe + 1) and ASSERT the cross-rank
       result == Σ_{pe in team}(pe+1) bit-exact on every rank. This is the genuine
       cross-GPU correctness assert (the symmetric heap addressing + a real
       collective over the carved team).

USAGE
    torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 tests/hw/nvshmem_smoke.py
    torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 tests/hw/nvshmem_smoke.py --ctas-per-pe 16 --n 4096

It exits 0 on success (rank 0 prints PASS) and non-zero with a precise message on
any failure (build / init / team / malloc / reduce mismatch).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def build_pybind(verbose: bool = False):
    """JIT-build the host NVSHMEM bring-up pybind. Separate module + build dir;
    never touches _ops. Returns the loaded module."""
    import torch  # noqa: PLC0415
    from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load  # noqa: PLC0415

    home = os.environ.get(
        "NVSHMEM_HOME", "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/nvidia/nvshmem")
    cuda = os.environ.get("CUDA_HOME", "/usr/local/cuda")
    src = str(ROOT / "csrc/fused/sm_90/nvshmem_bringup_pybind.cpp")
    if not os.path.isfile(src):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"pybind source missing: {src}")
    libdir = os.path.join(home, "lib")
    # The wheel ships only the versioned soname (libnvshmem_host.so.3) with no
    # unversioned .so symlink, so link the exact filename via ld's -l:NAME form and
    # rpath it so the .so loads without LD_LIBRARY_PATH.
    soname = None
    for cand in ("libnvshmem_host.so.3", "libnvshmem_host.so"):
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(libdir, cand)):
            soname = cand
            break
    if soname is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"libnvshmem_host.so* not found under {libdir}")

    os.environ["TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST"] = "9.0a"
    bd = os.environ.get("SG_TORCH_EXT_DIR", "/workspace/.torch_ext")
    bd = os.path.join(bd, "sg_nvshmem_bringup")
    os.makedirs(bd, exist_ok=True)
    return load(
        name="sg_nvshmem_bringup",
        sources=[src],
        build_directory=bd,
        extra_include_paths=[str(ROOT), os.path.join(home, "include"),
                             os.path.join(cuda, "include")],
        extra_cflags=["-O3", "-std=c++17"],
        extra_ldflags=[f"-L{libdir}", f"-l:{soname}",
                       f"-L{os.path.join(cuda, 'lib64')}", "-lcudart",
                       f"-Wl,-rpath,{libdir}"],
        verbose=verbose,
    )


def broadcast_uid(uid_bytes: bytes, *, src: int, device) -> bytes:
    """Broadcast the fixed-length UID blob over torch.distributed (NCCL). Every
    rank ends with rank-src's blob. The length is fixed (uniqueid_size); rank src
    supplies the bytes, the rest a zero buffer."""
    import torch  # noqa: PLC0415
    import torch.distributed as dist  # noqa: PLC0415

    n = len(uid_bytes) if uid_bytes is not None else None
    # length is a compile-time constant from the module; pass it in via the buffer
    # size the caller sized. We assume all ranks call with the same n (they do —
    # n == module.uniqueid_size()).
    assert n is not None
    buf = torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
    if dist.get_rank() == src:
        buf.copy_(torch.frombuffer(bytearray(uid_bytes), dtype=torch.uint8).to(device))
    dist.broadcast(buf, src=src)
    return bytes(buf.cpu().numpy().tobytes())


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,
                                 formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--tp", type=int, default=0,
                    help="TP degree (0 => world_size: single-node pure TP)")
    ap.add_argument("--ctas-per-pe", type=int, default=1,
                    help="ctas_per_pe driving the symmetric heap stride")
    ap.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=1024,
                    help="all-reduce element count for the smoke (<= heap/2)")
    ap.add_argument("--verbose-build", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    import torch  # noqa: PLC0415
    import torch.distributed as dist  # noqa: PLC0415
    from grokking_optimizers.host_bringup import (  # noqa: PLC0415
        TPBootstrap, tp_heap_stride_floats, NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD,
    )

    rank = int(os.environ.get("RANK", 0))
    world = int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", 1))
    local_rank = int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", 0))
    if world < 2:
        print("[smoke] WORLD_SIZE < 2 — this is a CROSS-GPU smoke; "
              "launch with torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 (or more).", flush=True)
        return 2

    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{local_rank}")
    dist.init_process_group(backend="nccl")

    tp = args.tp or world
    tp_rank = rank % tp
    dp = world // tp
    dp_rank = rank // tp
    plan = TPBootstrap(global_rank=rank, world_size=world, tp=tp, tp_rank=tp_rank,
                       dp=dp, dp_rank=dp_rank, ctas_per_pe=args.ctas_per_pe)
    plan.validate()
    pe_start, pe_stride, pe_size = plan.pe_range()
    sym_floats = tp_heap_stride_floats(args.ctas_per_pe)

    if rank == 0:
        print(f"[smoke] world={world} tp={tp} dp={dp}; "
              f"per-rank PE range=({pe_start},{pe_stride},{pe_size}); "
              f"sym_floats={sym_floats:,} (>= 2*n={2*args.n})", flush=True)

    # 1. build the pybind (every rank builds; ninja serializes via the lock — rank 0
    #    typically wins the compile, the rest load the cached .so).
    mod = build_pybind(verbose=args.verbose_build and rank == 0)
    n_uid = mod.uniqueid_size()

    # 2. UID bootstrap: rank 0 mints the UID, broadcast it, everyone inits.
    uid = mod.get_uniqueid() if rank == 0 else (b"\x00" * n_uid)
    uid = broadcast_uid(uid, src=0, device=device)
    assert len(uid) == n_uid, f"UID length {len(uid)} != {n_uid}"
    dist.barrier()
    mod.init_with_uniqueid(rank, world, uid, local_rank)
    assert mod.is_initialized()
    assert mod.world_pe() == rank, f"nvshmem pe {mod.world_pe()} != rank {rank}"
    assert mod.world_npes() == world
    if rank == 0:
        print(f"[smoke] nvshmem_init OK: world_pe={mod.world_pe()} "
              f"world_npes={mod.world_npes()}", flush=True)

    # 3. team split (collective over WORLD — all ranks call with their own pe_range;
    #    for single-node pure TP every rank's pe_range is identical).
    team = mod.team_split_strided(pe_start, pe_stride, pe_size)
    assert mod.tp_n_pes() == tp, f"team n_pes {mod.tp_n_pes()} != tp {tp}"
    assert mod.tp_local_pe() == tp_rank, \
        f"team local_pe {mod.tp_local_pe()} != tp_rank {tp_rank}"
    if rank == 0:
        is_world = (team == NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD)
        print(f"[smoke] team_split OK: handle={team} "
              f"(== NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD? {is_world}); "
              f"local_pe={mod.tp_local_pe()} n_pes={mod.tp_n_pes()}", flush=True)

    # 4. collective symmetric malloc.
    heap = mod.malloc_symmetric_heap(sym_floats)
    assert heap != 0, "symmetric heap malloc returned null"
    assert mod.sym_heap_floats() >= sym_floats
    if rank == 0:
        print(f"[smoke] nvshmem_malloc OK: heap_ptr=0x{heap:x} "
              f"floats={mod.sym_heap_floats():,}", flush=True)

    # 5. the cross-rank all-reduce assert.
    out = mod.tp_allreduce_smoke(args.n)
    # Expected: Σ over team members of (global_pe + 1). For single-node pure TP the
    # team is the whole world ⇒ Σ_{p=0..world-1}(p+1) = world*(world+1)/2.
    team_pes = [pe_start + i * pe_stride for i in range(pe_size)]
    expected = float(sum(p + 1 for p in team_pes))
    got_min = float(out.min().item())
    got_max = float(out.max().item())
    ok = (got_min == expected and got_max == expected)
    # Cross-rank agreement: gather every rank's first element + ok flag.
    flag = torch.tensor([1.0 if ok else 0.0, got_min, got_max, expected],
                        device=device, dtype=torch.float64)
    gathered = [torch.zeros_like(flag) for _ in range(world)]
    dist.all_gather(gathered, flag)
    all_ok = all(g[0].item() == 1.0 for g in gathered)
    # every rank in the same team must have the IDENTICAL reduced value.
    vals = [g[1].item() for g in gathered]
    cross_consistent = (max(vals) == min(vals) == expected)

    if rank == 0:
        print(f"[smoke] all-reduce: expected={expected} "
              f"got=[{got_min},{got_max}] per-rank-ok={ok}", flush=True)
        for r, g in enumerate(gathered):
            print(f"    rank {r}: ok={int(g[0].item())} "
                  f"min={g[1].item()} max={g[2].item()} expected={g[3].item()}",
                  flush=True)

    mod.barrier_world()
    dist.barrier()
    mod.finalize()

    if not (all_ok and cross_consistent):
        if rank == 0:
            print("[smoke] FAIL: cross-rank all-reduce mismatch", flush=True)
        dist.destroy_process_group()
        return 1

    if rank == 0:
        print(f"[smoke] PASS: NVSHMEM UID bootstrap + team split + symmetric malloc "
              f"+ cross-rank all-reduce correct across {world} GPUs.", flush=True)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

content.text:
This is a precise, scoped blocker — and it's recoverable. The bring-up gets all the way to NVSHMEM team setup. The failure is:

```
team_internal_nvls.cpp:263: cuMemMap failed to map 274877906944 bytes ... NVLS resource initialization failed for team ID: 0
```

NVSHMEM 3.7 defaults to **NVLS (NVLink SHARP multicast)** for the world team, which requires `cuMemMap`-ing a huge multicast group (256 GiB). In this RunPod container, multicast/`cuMemCreate` with the MULTICAST handle type is not permitted (the same class of container capability restriction as the ncu perf-counter blocker in MEMORY). The fix is to **disable NVLS** via `NVSHMEM_DISABLE_NVLS=1`. The libibverbs warnings are harmless (IB transport skipped; single-node uses P2P/NVLink). Let me retry with NVLS disabled.

The 2-GPU NVSHMEM smoke PASSES. The full bring-up works end-to-end:
- `nvshmem_init` via UID bootstrap over torch.distributed: OK (world_pe assignments correct)
- `nvshmem_team_split_strided`: OK (handle=7, local_pe/n_pes correct)
- collective `nvshmem_malloc` of the symmetric heap: OK
- cross-rank team all-reduce: expected=3.0 (=1+2), got 3.0 on every rank, bit-exact

The only required env knob is `NVSHMEM_DISABLE_NVLS=1` (the container blocks NVLS multicast `cuMemMap`). Note: for pure-TP TP=world the team handle came back as 7 (not NVSHMEM_TEAM_WORLD=0) because `team_split_strided` always mints a new team even when it spans the whole world. This is fine — the launcher reads the handle from CommCtx; the `is_pure_tp_world` fast-path in the plan is just an optimization hint. Let me note this.

"""grokking_optimizers/nvshmem_bringup_ext.py — the LIVE NVSHMEM bring-up driver.

This is the runtime companion of grokking_optimizers/host_bringup.py (the CPU plan).
host_bringup.py validates the plan offline and, with no Python NVSHMEM binding, can
only raise a scoped TPBootstrapBlocked. THIS module is the missing piece the GOAL
asks for: it JIT-builds the host NVSHMEM bring-up pybind
(csrc/fused/sm_90/nvshmem_bringup_pybind.cpp, linked host-only against
libnvshmem_host.so.3) and drives the real three-step bring-up:

    1. nvshmem_init via the UID bootstrap (nvshmemx_get_uniqueid +
       nvshmemx_hostlib_init_attr(NVSHMEMX_INIT_WITH_UNIQUEID)), the UID broadcast
       over torch.distributed (NCCL) — MPI/PMI are absent; the nvshmem_bootstrap_uid
       plugin IS present.
    2. nvshmem_team_split_strided for the TP team (PE range from the TPBootstrap plan).
    3. the COLLECTIVE nvshmem_malloc of the symmetric tp_sym_heap (sized to
       host_bringup.tp_heap_stride_floats(ctas_per_pe), matching the launcher's
       dec_tc_ensure_tp_sym_heap exactly).

CONTAINER NVLS BLOCKER (scoped, mitigated): NVSHMEM 3.7 + NCCL both default to NVLS
(NVLink-SHARP multicast) for the world team, which needs a multicast cuMemMap that
this RunPod container forbids (cuMemMap of the MC group fails with CUDA 'invalid
argument' — the SAME class of container capability restriction as the ncu
perf-counter blocker). The mitigation is to disable NVLS for BOTH stacks:
NVSHMEM_DISABLE_NVLS=1 and NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0. We set these defaults at import (the
operator can override) so the UID + P2P/NVLink path — which works — is taken.

The built module exposes (see the pybind TU): get_uniqueid / uniqueid_size /
init_with_uniqueid / team_split_strided / malloc_symmetric_heap / tp_allreduce_smoke
/ barrier_world / finalize / is_initialized / world_pe / world_npes / tp_local_pe /
tp_n_pes / sym_heap_ptr / sym_heap_floats.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from grokking_optimizers.host_bringup import (
    TPBootstrap, TPBootstrapBlocked, tp_heap_stride_floats, find_nvshmem_host_lib,
)

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
_PYBIND_SRC = ROOT / "csrc/fused/sm_90/nvshmem_bringup_pybind.cpp"

# Container NVLS blocker mitigation — set BEFORE NCCL/NVSHMEM init (idempotent;
# operator-overridable). See module docstring.
def set_nvls_disabled_defaults() -> None:
    os.environ.setdefault("NVSHMEM_DISABLE_NVLS", "1")
    os.environ.setdefault("NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE", "0")


# Apply at import so a `torch.distributed.init_process_group` later in the same
# process (NCCL) also picks up NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0 — the 8-GPU NCCL collective hits
# the same NVLS cuMemMap blocker otherwise.
set_nvls_disabled_defaults()

_MODULE = None


def _nvshmem_home() -> str:
    return os.environ.get(
        "NVSHMEM_HOME", "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/nvidia/nvshmem")


def _nvshmem_soname(libdir: str) -> Optional[str]:
    # The wheel ships only the versioned soname (libnvshmem_host.so.3) with no
    # unversioned .so symlink, so we link the exact filename via ld's -l:NAME form.
    for cand in ("libnvshmem_host.so.3", "libnvshmem_host.so"):
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(libdir, cand)):
            return cand
    try:
        for fn in sorted(os.listdir(libdir)):
            if fn.startswith("libnvshmem_host.so"):
                return fn
    except OSError:
        pass
    return None


def build_bringup_module(*, verbose: bool = False):
    """JIT-build (or load cached) the host NVSHMEM bring-up pybind. Separate module
    name + build dir — never touches _ops or the committed launcher TUs. Raises
    TPBootstrapBlocked with a precise reason if the toolkit is not discoverable."""
    global _MODULE
    if _MODULE is not None:
        return _MODULE
    if not _PYBIND_SRC.is_file():
        raise TPBootstrapBlocked(f"pybind source missing: {_PYBIND_SRC}")
    if find_nvshmem_host_lib() is None:
        raise TPBootstrapBlocked(
            "NVSHMEM host lib not found (libnvshmem_host.so.* under $NVSHMEM_HOME / "
            "the pip wheel) — cannot build the bring-up pybind.")
    home = _nvshmem_home()
    libdir = os.path.join(home, "lib")
    soname = _nvshmem_soname(libdir)
    if soname is None:
        raise TPBootstrapBlocked(f"libnvshmem_host.so* not found under {libdir}")
    cuda = os.environ.get("CUDA_HOME", "/usr/local/cuda")

    import torch  # noqa: PLC0415  (only needed for the live build)
    from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load  # noqa: PLC0415

    os.environ["TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST"] = "9.0a"
    bd = os.path.join(os.environ.get("SG_TORCH_EXT_DIR", "/workspace/.torch_ext"),
                      "sg_nvshmem_bringup")
    os.makedirs(bd, exist_ok=True)
    _MODULE = load(
        name="sg_nvshmem_bringup",
        sources=[str(_PYBIND_SRC)],
        build_directory=bd,
        extra_include_paths=[str(ROOT), os.path.join(home, "include"),
                             os.path.join(cuda, "include")],
        extra_cflags=["-O3", "-std=c++17"],
        extra_ldflags=[f"-L{libdir}", f"-l:{soname}",
                       f"-L{os.path.join(cuda, 'lib64')}", "-lcudart",
                       f"-Wl,-rpath,{libdir}"],
        verbose=verbose,
    )
    return _MODULE


def bringup_tp_team_live(plan: TPBootstrap, *, uid_broadcast, device_ordinal: int,
                         verbose_build: bool = False):
    """Drive the REAL NVSHMEM TP-team bring-up for THIS rank and return a dict of
    the resolved CommCtx fields (the launcher's host view of EDIT E) PLUS the live
    module so the caller can run a smoke/allocate further. The collective ops
    (init / team split / malloc) are entered on every rank in lock-step.

    ``uid_broadcast`` is ``(uid_bytes_or_None) -> uid_bytes`` (a tiny
    torch.distributed broadcast of the 128-byte UID blob): rank 0 supplies the
    minted blob, the rest supply None and receive it. ``device_ordinal`` is the
    local CUDA device (== LOCAL_RANK) NVSHMEM binds its symmetric heap to.

    Returns (mod, commctx_fields). Raises TPBootstrapBlocked on any bring-up failure
    (carrying the precise NVSHMEM/CUDA error)."""
    plan.validate()
    set_nvls_disabled_defaults()
    try:
        mod = build_bringup_module(verbose=verbose_build)
    except Exception as e:  # build/link failure is a precise, actionable blocker
        raise TPBootstrapBlocked(f"NVSHMEM bring-up pybind build failed: {e}") from e

    n_uid = mod.uniqueid_size()
    is_rank0 = (plan.global_rank == 0)
    uid_local = mod.get_uniqueid() if is_rank0 else None
    uid = uid_broadcast(uid_local)
    if uid is None or len(uid) != n_uid:
        raise TPBootstrapBlocked(
            f"UID broadcast returned {0 if uid is None else len(uid)} bytes, "
            f"expected {n_uid} (the torch.distributed broadcast of the 128-byte "
            f"nvshmemx_uniqueid_t blob is the bring-up's rendezvous).")
    try:
        mod.init_with_uniqueid(plan.global_rank, plan.world_size, uid, device_ordinal)
    except Exception as e:
        raise TPBootstrapBlocked(
            f"nvshmem_init (UID bootstrap) failed: {e}. If this is an NVLS "
            f"cuMemMap error, the container forbids NVLink-SHARP multicast — "
            f"NVSHMEM_DISABLE_NVLS=1 is set by default; check it survived.") from e

    pe_start, pe_stride, pe_size = plan.pe_range()
    try:
        team = mod.team_split_strided(pe_start, pe_stride, pe_size)
    except Exception as e:
        raise TPBootstrapBlocked(
            f"nvshmem_team_split_strided({pe_start},{pe_stride},{pe_size}) "
            f"failed: {e}") from e

    sym_floats = tp_heap_stride_floats(plan.ctas_per_pe)
    try:
        heap_ptr = mod.malloc_symmetric_heap(sym_floats)
    except Exception as e:
        raise TPBootstrapBlocked(
            f"collective nvshmem_malloc({sym_floats} floats) failed: {e}") from e

    # The launcher's CommCtx view (host_bringup.TPBootstrap.commctx_fields), with
    # the LIVE team handle + symmetric heap pointer filled in.
    fields = plan.commctx_fields(team)
    fields["tp_sym_heap_ptr"] = heap_ptr
    fields["tp_team_n_pes"] = mod.tp_n_pes()
    fields["tp_team_local_pe"] = mod.tp_local_pe()
    return mod, fields


__all__ = [
    "set_nvls_disabled_defaults",
    "build_bringup_module",
    "bringup_tp_team_live",
]

    # This is the REAL bring-up (the GOAL's capability track): it JIT-builds the
    # host NVSHMEM pybind, drives nvshmem_init via the UID bootstrap broadcast over
    # this NCCL PG, carves the TP team with nvshmem_team_split_strided, and runs the
    # collective nvshmem_malloc of the symmetric tp_sym_heap — all matching the
    # launcher's dec_tc_ensure_tp_sym_heap + EDIT-E CommCtx fields exactly. The
    # resolved CommCtx fields (team handle + symmetric heap ptr) are what the launcher
    # reads on the kTPComm path. Replaces the old TPBootstrapBlocked stub.
    nvshmem_fields = None
    if args.nvshmem:
        from grokking_optimizers.nvshmem_bringup_ext import (  # noqa: PLC0415
            bringup_tp_team_live,
        )

        def _uid_bcast(uid):  # fixed-length torch.distributed broadcast of the UID
            import torch as _t  # noqa: PLC0415
            # 128-byte nvshmemx_uniqueid_t blob; rank 0 supplies the minted bytes.
